name: Nidal LYASSAMI
role: Work-study student — Software architecture & AI / automation
intro: I'm not just a dev who shipped a few projects: I build and run my own systems, from the homelab to the entrepreneurial app.

blocks.title: Who
blocks.text: Work-study MAALSI student (CESI Strasbourg), specialised in software architecture & AI/automation, on a work-study contract at Würth France (WDS unit).

blocks.title: What I do
blocks.text: I design and deploy AI/automation tools autonomously (WDS Track, WDS Copilote), I lead a social-impact entrepreneurial project (Blind Map, SNEE) and I run my own infrastructure (Kloud, Proxmox/VPS homelab).

blocks.title: Outside the code
blocks.text: Football (5-a-side on Sundays), narrative games (Outer Wilds, Firewatch), and founder of the Eteint Play association.
